repository_card.frontier: M0 is a commutative forest algebra; admissible-cut coproduct, coassociativity and antipode are the next algebraic obligations. No directly relevant 3-9 September source was verified.
repository_card.bridge_hypothesis: The planar LOT construction supplies an adjacent representation to audit, not a drop-in coproduct. Dictionary: ordered forests -> noncommutative words; forgetting order -> a weighted commutative image. Degree is retained; planar multiplicity and cut admissibility can be lost.
repository_card.next_finite_task: Enumerate trees through five vertices and compare ordinary cuts with left-admissible cuts. First determine the exact symmetrization weights, then test the coalgebra compatibility square on each basis element.
repository_card.falsifier: One coefficient mismatch falsifies the naive forget-order map. Do not use a planar Hopf identity as the commutative Connes-Kreimer coproduct theorem.
repository_card.proposal_status: speculative; not executed or formally verified

sources.source_claim: Yu, Gao and Manchon construct a planar noncommutative multi-index Hopf algebra, relate it to Munthe-Kaas-Wright through a fertility map, and describe left-admissible cuts and symmetrization.
sources.limits: Planar order and noncommutative products differ from the commutative Connes-Kreimer forest algebra. An algebraic correspondence does not supply analytic cluster convergence. First posted 12 July.
